title: 第1345章 最后一战第1344章 你什么都不懂
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
之后的几个小时里，科索向自己的孩子们表达了缺席他们人生的歉意，诉说了对他们的思念后，一个军官来到科索面前说道：
“神王陛下，都准备好了。”
科索朝军官点了点头，军官走了出去，最后科索把自己的视线，再次投向那三个孩子。
“孩子们，是时候分别了，我是你们的父亲，可也是日月神国的神王。
日月神国落到如今的局面，我负有主要责任，现在是我承担一切的时候了。
你们且离去吧，若有来世，我一定会竭尽全力做一个好父亲。”
三个孩子这会儿都已经泪流满面了，不愿意走。
科索则是从自己腰间，拔出两把大口径左轮手枪，放在自己的长子面前。
“把这个交给你们的教父，他会知道是什么意思的。”
科达拉接过左轮手枪后，科索的视线再次放在迅拉身上。
“迅拉，带着孩子们离开吧，放心，厄忒斯是孩子们的教父，他是不会为难你们的。
带着孩子们，去兽牙半岛生活吧，只要厄忒斯还在，他会保护你们的，不用担心大首领对你们不利”
迅拉带着他的孩子们走了，几个小时后，返回到联盟那边的阵地。
联盟的阵地上已经架设了很多门180重炮，因为知道兽人那边没有相关的反制火炮，所以180重炮阵地排列非常密集，丝毫不在意对方会用同等的火炮反制。
大量的炮弹就这么并排摆开，放在最容易射击的位置，大量的联盟步兵，已经排列成可以进攻的阵型。
磨刀霍霍，兵锋直指鹰眼山！
迅拉和三个孩子们见到这一幕，心不由自主的为鹰眼山内的科索担忧了起来。
厄忒斯收到手下士兵的消息，迅拉和三个孩子们回来了，立马从指挥部里赶出来，前来迎接四人。
他看到这4个人孤零零的回来，并没有带出科索，就知道科索是怎么想的了。
在心中哀叹一声后，他赶忙说道：

“来，跟我来，离开这里，以后你们就跟我一起生活吧，我会照顾好你们的。”
厄忒斯马上就要下令进攻鹰眼山了，这种时候他也不知道要怎么安慰科索的妻儿，只能做出对他们未来的保障。
科达拉走上前来，把两把左轮手枪递给厄忒斯。
“教父，这是我父亲让我转交给你的。”
厄忒斯接过这两把大口径左轮手枪，白银制的。
当初科索离开联盟的时候，两人在一起喝酒，厄忒斯就把自己的配枪送给了科索。
如今科索把这两把枪还回来，其实是在告诉他：接下来你我二人死斗，我不能用你送我的武器打你，这不道义，所以把你送我的枪还给你。
厄忒斯读懂了这个意思，科索这是要和他进行拼死一搏，这是斩断双方之间最后一点情谊。
这时科特突然激动的说道：“教父！能不能把我父亲俘虏，不要杀他！”
厄忒斯苦笑一声。
“我尽量。”
之后他就带着几个孩子，往后山指挥部走。
他们走了刚没一会儿，一个龙虎军的军官就接管了指挥。
他看了一眼手表，下午6点左右，这个时候的太阳已经不那么炎热了，士兵们进行高强度运动，不会大幅度消耗体力，正是进攻的时候。
他高高举起手，狠狠挥下。
“开炮！！”
轰轰轰！！！
轰轰轰！！！
这一瞬间，百炮齐发！
content_en:
In the next few hours, Corso expressed his apology to his children for missing their lives and expressed his thoughts about them. After that, an officer came to Corso and said:
"Your Majesty the God King, everything is ready."
Corso nodded to the officer, and the officer walked out. Finally, Corso turned his attention to the three children again.
"Children, it's time to say goodbye. I am your father, but I am also the divine king of the Sun and Moon Kingdom.
I bear the main responsibility for the situation that the Sun and Moon Divine Kingdom has fallen into. Now is the time for me to take responsibility for everything.
You can leave now. If there is an afterlife, I will do my best to be a good father. "
The three children were all in tears now and were unwilling to leave.
Corso pulled out two large-caliber revolvers from his waist and placed them in front of his eldest son.
"Give this to your godfather, he will know what it means."
After Kodala took the revolver, Koso's eyes were on Xun Ra again.
"Xunla, take the children and leave. Don't worry, Ertes is the godfather of the children and he will not make things difficult for you.
Take your children and go live on the Beast Tooth Peninsula. As long as Etes is still there, he will protect you. Don’t worry about the big boss doing anything bad to you."
Xunla took his children away and returned to the Alliance's position a few hours later.
Many 180-meter heavy artillery have been set up on the alliance's position. Because they know that the Orcs do not have relevant counter-artillery, the 180-meter heavy artillery positions are arranged very densely, and they do not care that the other party will counterattack with equal artillery.
A large number of artillery shells were placed side by side, placed in the easiest shooting position, and a large number of Union infantry were arranged in an offensive formation.
Sharpening the sword, the soldiers are pointing directly at Eagle Eye Mountain!
When Xunla and the three children saw this scene, they couldn't help but worry about Corso in Eagle Eye Mountain.
Etes received the news from his soldiers that Xunla and the three children were back, and immediately rushed out of the headquarters to greet the four of them.
When he saw these four people coming back alone without taking Corso out, he knew what Corso was thinking.
After lamenting in his heart, he hurriedly said:
"Come, follow me, leave here, you can live with me from now on, I will take good care of you."
Etes was about to order an attack on Eagle Eye Mountain. At this time, he didn't know how to comfort Corso's wife and children. He could only guarantee their future.
Cordala stepped forward and handed Etes the two revolvers.
"Godfather, my father asked me to give this to you."
Etes took the two large-caliber revolvers, made of silver.
When Corso left the alliance, the two drank together, and Etes gave Corso his gun.
Now that Corso returned the two guns, he was actually telling him: Next, you and I will fight to the death. I can't hit you with the weapons you gave me. This is unethical, so I will return the guns you gave me.
Etes understood this meaning. Corso was going to fight him to the death, which was to cut off the last bit of friendship between the two parties.
At this time, Kurt suddenly said excitedly: "Godfather! Can you capture my father and don't kill him?"
Ertes smiled bitterly.
"I'll try my best."
After that, he took a few children and walked to the back mountain headquarters.
Not long after they left, an officer from the Dragon and Tiger Army took over the command.
He glanced at his watch. Around 6 p.m., the sun was no longer so hot at this time. The soldiers were performing high-intensity exercises that would not consume a lot of energy. It was the time to attack.
He raised his hand high and waved it down hard.
"Fire!!"
Boom boom boom! ! !
Boom boom boom! ! !
At this moment, hundreds of guns fired!
